competences.description: Attacks and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Increases Attack Power and Defense of all allies for 2 turns. Increases Attack Power and Defense for 3 turns and creates a shield that absorbs damage for 3 turns on all allies if GREAT is activated with a 30% chance. The shield amount is proportionate to your level.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.

competences.description: Allies with Attack Power increasing effect will decrease the enemy's Defense for 1 turn with a 50% chance when they attack. Allies with Defense increasing effect will decrease the enemy's Attack Power for 1 turn with a 50% chance when they are attacked. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
effets.note: If ally has Attack Power increasing effect

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
effets.note: If ally has Defense increasing effect
